name: Release Hygiene & Publisher Reliability Maintenance
changes: Synchronizes remaining current-version fallbacks in the app HTML shell, tray helper, runtime identities, and release-facing documentation.
Makes current SABCTools/yEnc integration wording version-neutral while retaining the pinned SABCTools 9.6.3 implementation and decoder behavior.
Corrects guarded publisher verification to monitor Pages on the source/content commit and accept a newer successful deployment after an older superseded cancellation.
Verifies the immutable annotated release tag by peeling the tag object to its source commit instead of relying on GitHub Release target_commitish.
regression_guards: The v3.7.3 managed /SILENT Setup update lifecycle and exact launch arguments must remain unchanged.
Private SABnzbd 5.1.2 and SABCTools 9.6.3 provenance must remain unchanged.
The retired standalone NewzDeckYenc.exe and copied update-coordinator architectures must remain absent.
styles.css and themes.css must remain byte-identical to the v3.7.3 production payload.
preserved: Private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Direct Unpack/post-processing, PAR2/repair, article cache and async disk behavior.
Automation, Smart Import, Newsgroup Browser performance/concurrency behavior, Backup & Restore, and all twelve themes.
Metadata Server 0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector 1.0.31 remain separate unchanged components.
